title: Active Directory ACL Abuse (GenericAll)
description: A single Samba Active Directory Domain Controller for NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL, no Windows VMs. The low-privilege foothold user hodor holds a dangerous GenericAll access-control entry over the higher-value account maester.luwin, which guards an archive share. Full control over a user object includes the right to reset its password without the old one: find the control edge, reset maester.luwin's password, authenticate as maester.luwin, and read the flag from a share hodor cannot open.
question: From the hodor foothold, abuse the GenericAll ACE over maester.luwin to reset its password, then authenticate as maester.luwin and read the flag from the //dc/archive share.
